sentences.text: Dimas membaca kumpulan mitos dari seluruh Nusantara.
sentences.en: Dimas read a collection of myths from across the archipelago.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 누산타라 곳곳의 신화 모음집을 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Penjaga warung di stasiun bercerita tentang mitos hantu di terowongan tua.
sentences.en: The stall keeper at the station told a myth about a ghost in the old tunnel.
sentences.ko: 역 매점 주인은 옛 터널에 귀신이 있다는 전설을 들려줬어요.

sentences.text: Klub drama memakai ruang serbaguna perpustakaan untuk latihan teater.
sentences.en: The drama club uses the library's multipurpose room for theater practice.
sentences.ko: 연극반은 도서관 다목적실에서 연극 연습을 해요.

sentences.text: Putri sedang dalam perjalanan ke Jakarta untuk menonton pertunjukan teater.
sentences.en: Putri is on her way to Jakarta to watch a theater performance.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 연극 공연을 보러 자카르타로 가는 길이에요.

sentences.text: Dalam novel itu, ayah tokoh utama adalah seorang pemabuk yang akhirnya berubah.
sentences.en: In the novel, the main character's father is a drunkard who eventually changes.
sentences.ko: 그 소설에서 주인공 아버지는 결국 달라지는 술꾼이에요.

sentences.text: Petugas keamanan menurunkan seorang pemabuk yang membuat keributan di gerbong.
sentences.en: Security staff removed a drunk who was making a commotion in the carriage.
sentences.ko: 보안 요원이 칸에서 소란을 피운 술 취한 사람을 내리게 했어요.
